name: io.github.Fizzl13/presign-guard-wallet
title: presign-guard wallet
description: Agent wallet with spending limits: pays x402 and MPP APIs (Base, Tempo), phone approval over limit.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of the agent's own wallet (a separate wallet holding only what the agent may spend)

environmentVariables.name: LIMIT_USDC_PER_TX
environmentVariables.description: Most USDC per payment or transfer without asking you, e.g. 5

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Telegram bot that asks you to approve anything over a limit

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Telegram chat id (approvals go only there)

environmentVariables.name: WALLET_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Instead of LIMIT_* and TELEGRAM_*: a wallet server keeping one budget for all your agents

environmentVariables.name: WALLET_SERVER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent key (awk_…) from the wallet server's dashboard

environmentVariables.name: CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: base (default), ethereum, optimism, arbitrum, polygon or bsc

environmentVariables.name: MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most a single x402 API call may cost, in dollars (default 1)

environmentVariables.name: PRESIGN_CREDIT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional presign-guard credit key (pgc_…) to pay the $0.01 checks from prepaid credits

environmentVariables.name: RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional RPC URL for the chain

environmentVariables.name: TEMPO
environmentVariables.description: off to never pay MPP charges on Tempo (default on: paid in USDC.e on Tempo from the same address)

environmentVariables.name: MPP_SESSION_DEPOSIT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: pay MPP sessions on Tempo; the USDC.e each channel deposit or top-up puts in (counted toward the USDC limits); then each call is a signed voucher

environmentVariables.name: XRPL_SEED
environmentVariables.description: Optional: the agent's own XRPL account seed; pays x402 offers in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (counted toward the USDC limits)
